base_source: TTM through Q2 2026 from EDGAR 10-Q YTD (OCF $2,100.182M = FY25 $1,796.358M - H1'25 $643.176M + H1'26 $947.000M; minus capex TTM $456.003M and SBC TTM $1,142.306M = $501.873M / 714.246M H1'26 diluted shares); engine normalized 3-yr median was -$0.58 and latest FY +$0.33 — median rejected as a pre-inflection artifact, see analysis.md
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 1.4% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 6.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
DILUTION: share count growing 5.0%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
moat_justification: Two-sided network effects at 123M DAU scale, a creator ecosystem and content library rivals cannot copy quickly, and social-graph/identity lock-in for a cohort growing up on the platform — but no owned IP or content exclusivity (creators multi-home), pricing power unproven and currently backwards (bookings per DAU -1.6% in Q2 2026, DevEx rate raised), a structural child-safety regulatory/litigation tax (age checks cut engagement density in 2026), and no proven returns on capital (GAAP losses in every year of history).
name: Roblox Corporation
one_liner: Real UGC gaming platform, moat 6/10, finally inflected to positive owner's earnings ($0.70/share TTM) — but at $49.51 (~70x TTM OE, 1.4% yield) with Q3 2026 bookings guided down 14-18%, it clears only a 5.7% weighted IRR (IV@15% $10.66); it would need to trade near $11 to clear the 15% hurdle.
